root.label: Chicago-area Dutch Bros location surpasses USC shop sales

events.label: Chicago-area Dutch Bros location surpasses USC shop sales

slots.name: sales ranking
slots.sentence: The location—which features three windows, for ordering, pickup and mobile orders—had the highest sales volume of any Dutch Bros coffee shop until May, when it was surpassed by the opening of the first Chicago-area location, according to Chief Financial Officer Josh Guenser.
